purpose: Supplementary render-publication investigation questions; separate from frozen historical retrieval evaluation.

questions.query: Does the graphical retained full plus dirty render publication overflow still happen with ordinary ACK, and is E enabled by default?
facts: The frozen-main real Main graphical investigation reproduces byte-only forced retries with normal and withheld ACK; incidence is instrumented fixture and platform scoped.
E is an explicitly selected test-only complete-baseline exemption with bounded dirty budgets, no drop/rebase or implicit ACK; ordinary defaults remain unchanged.
Texture.update CPU return and a final frame/readback do not establish GPU-completion timing or human PLAY acceptance.

questions.query: Does run-based native render copy R change ordinary rendering or supersede the E ACK retention experiment?
facts: R is compiled only in standalone experimental test builds; ordinary native publication still calls the original copy method.
Byte-exact native differential/nonmutation tests and paired warm extraction timings are independent of worker retries and texture upload.
R reduces individual full-extraction cost; E removes retained-baseline overflow retries. Neither selects the other or establishes GPU pacing; existing PR290 owns production render-copy integration.
